items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: I played with him on the Battle House.

ctx.x: Yeah, Barrel House number. Wish I Had A Nickel? Wish I Had A Nickel?

Them guys go around and fish fry years ago and play that. Wish I Had A Nickel? They say, no I got a nickel and you got a dime. Let's get together and buy some wine. There was a guy called Barrel House. Do you remember him? He played the guitar? Yeah, I know Barrel House. What happened to him? He died, didn't he?
Oh, you told me you saw him, I guess in October you told me you saw him. Yeah, I did. I did see him, but I, you know, it's been common.
